intro: TRANSACT actively contributes to the international research community through workshops, conference presentations, invited lectures, and the organization of scientific panels. These activities foster collaboration, disseminate research findings, and strengthen an international network dedicated to Freedom of Information (FOI), transparency, and democratic governance.

items.title: Transparency in Action – International Perspectives from Experimental Research on Freedom of Information Laws
lines: TRANSACT organized a two-day international workshop bringing together leading scholars and practitioners working on Freedom of Information laws and transparency governance. The workshop combined research presentations, roundtables with civil society organizations, and collaborative sessions dedicated to designing comparative field experiments in Belgium, Romania, Switzerland, South Africa, and Uganda. It laid the foundations for the international research network that now supports the TRANSACT project.
